title: More and More!
description: hi! this mod add's *more and more* items that can be crafted with vanilla only resources (and there's some blocks and things just for fun so ignore it)
body:
Hi there! this mod add's *_more and more_* items that can be crafted with vanilla only resources
And it add's more fun to play because you don't have to find something *new* in world
Only new items and paintings
